Term: Player stats cannot go below 0 (except HP).

Description: Levels determine which abilities an entity has access to. A move can only be used if the user has the required Level.

Health Points starts at the entity's Max HP and is lowered by taking damage. HP cannot exceed Max HP.
When an entity is at 0 or less HP, they are removed from the game.
Maximum HP does not change from taking damage, but it can by affected by items and certain effects.
Attack is added to the damage of physical attacks.
Magic is added to the damage of magical attacks.
Physical Defense is subtracted from the damage of incoming physical attacks.
Magical Defense is subtracted from the damage of incoming magical attacks.
Evasion rounds down. An attack misses if its accuracy roll is less than [the attack's MR] + [the target's EVA].

Movement Points determine how many tiles an entity's Basic Movement action can move over.
MP can also be spent on certain effects. They are refreshed at the start of each turn.
